settings.heading: Free UK shipping, every order
settings.subheading: We currently ship to UK addresses only, at no extra cost.

settings.question: Will it hold my tablet, not just my phone?
settings.answer: Yes, for most tablets — the adjustable grip is designed to securely hold phones and compact-to-mid-size tablets. We don’t recommend it for full-size iPads or heavier tablets, which can be too heavy for the base.

settings.question: Does it work in both portrait and landscape?
settings.answer: Yes, simply rotate your device — the grip adjusts to hold it securely either way.

settings.question: Will it scratch my phone case?
settings.answer: No — every contact point is lined with soft anti-slip padding.

settings.question: How tall is the stand when fully extended?
settings.answer: See the product page for exact dimensions at minimum and maximum height.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on every order, no questions asked.
